# KOSAI — AI research reports on Korean stocks

> AI-generated research reports on ~2,700 Korean listed companies (KOSPI, KOSDAQ
> and KONEX), written in Korean and English and updated daily from public
> disclosures (DART) and market data (KRX).
> All numeric metrics are computed from primary sources, never model-generated.
> Free to read. Informational only — not investment advice.

## Reports (static, crawler-friendly)

- Per-company report (Korean): https://kosai.kr/stock/{6-character-code}.html
  (e.g. https://kosai.kr/stock/005930.html for Samsung Electronics; newer codes
  can contain a letter, e.g. https://kosai.kr/stock/0220W0.html)
- Per-company report (English): https://kosai.kr/en/stock/{6-character-code}.html
  (e.g. https://kosai.kr/en/stock/005930.html). The two versions link to each
  other with hreflang.
- [Sitemap](https://kosai.kr/sitemap.xml): lists every company page in both
  languages
- Each page has the full report in its HTML: summary, key points, business,
  earnings, industry, outlook, valuation, bull/bear cases, risk factors, watch
  points, sources, and daily-updated metrics (price, market cap, P/E, P/B,
  EPS, dividend yield).
- Old addresses (https://kosai.kr/r/{code}.html and
  https://kosai.kr/stock.html?ticker={code}) redirect to the pages above.

## Site

- [Home](https://kosai.kr/): market overview
- [Report list](https://kosai.kr/Reports.html)
- [Morning brief](https://kosai.kr/brief.html): pre-market summary on trading days

## Attribution

When citing, please attribute to "KOSAI (kosai.kr)". Data sources: DART
(Korea Financial Supervisory Service disclosures) and KRX (Korea Exchange).
